name: tecnico-mail
description: Read, search, and draft mail in your own Técnico (IST) mailbox. Runs on your computer. Not affiliated with IST or DSI.
long_description:
Connects Claude to your own Técnico mailbox over IMAP and SMTP, the same way Thunderbird does. It runs on your computer, and your password goes only to mail.tecnico.ulisboa.pt. Claude Desktop keeps the password in your system keychain.

The mail Claude reads goes to Anthropic like anything else in your conversation, so think twice about confidential mail. Unofficial: this project is not affiliated with IST or DSI.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search on the server, newest first

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Read a message as clean text

tools.name: get_attachment
tools.description: Read the text of a PDF, DOCX, or text file

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Save a draft for you to review

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: Mark messages as read or unread

tools.name: move_message
tools.description: Move messages to another folder or to Trash

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send mail (only if you allow sending)

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Send a reply (only if you allow sending)

tecnico_id.title: Técnico ID
tecnico_id.description: Your login, in the form istxxxxx. Not your email address.

password.title: Password
password.description: Your Técnico ID password. Stored in your system keychain and sent only to mail.tecnico.ulisboa.pt.

email.title: Técnico email address
email.description: The address you chose at activation, such as ana.silva@tecnico.ulisboa.pt. It is never istxxxxx@tecnico.ulisboa.pt.

name.title: Your name
name.description: Shown on mail you send. Optional.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Claude can read mail, but can't save drafts or change anything.

allow_send.title: Allow sending
allow_send.description: Lets Claude send mail as you. Off means Claude can only save drafts, which is safer because an email could try to trick it.
